records.semanticMeaning: TARGET Services are supported as a functioning European financial-settlement carrier for current payment, securities and collateral flows.
records.exactMechanism: Integrated central-bank settlement platforms carry payment, securities, instant-payment and collateral-management operations at large scale.
records.whySupported: ECB annual reporting shows high-volume current use and a fully integrated suite of settlement services rather than planned infrastructure alone.
doesNotEstablish: Uniform use across every EU member state
Growth in the broader real economy
records.competingInterpretation: The carrier is institutionally centred on the Eurosystem and should not be generalized beyond its actual scope.

records.semanticMeaning: The EU industrial subsystem is supported as an ongoing organized runtime even though aggregate output momentum is weak.
records.exactMechanism: Current production continues while transport and digital infrastructure route and coordinate industrial activity across an existing multi-state system.
records.whySupported: Current Eurostat production data confirms active industrial output, while TEN-T and Digital Decade evidence establish operating and upgrading network conditions.
records.competingInterpretation: Near-stagnant aggregate production may indicate a constrained runtime rather than a robust one.
unresolvedEvidence: Persistence of weak output and member-state/sector divergence.

records.semanticMeaning: Energy-import dependence and current energy-linked producer-price pressure are supported as active constraints on the European industrial-economic runtime.
records.exactMechanism: A large imported share of EU energy needs exposes the system to external supply and price conditions, while 2026 energy producer-price increases transmit those conditions into current industrial costs.
records.whySupported: Eurostat directly measures both structural import dependence and current energy-linked producer-price pressure.
records.competingInterpretation: Domestic generation, fuel mix and supplier diversification reduce or redistribute exposure across countries.
unresolvedEvidence: Duration and country-specific pass-through of current energy price pressure.

blocked.reason: Import-composition change is real, but current evidence does not yet establish the direct cross-time adaptation mechanism needed for G14+P3 RP admission.

boundary: Only EVIDENCE_READY EU semantic bases advance. Candidate generation is not position admission.
